artifact_policy: Target and projector bytes unchanged; full-RAM experts and PLE. Draft experiments do not change target weights.

rebuild.source: Export the pinned Strata commit into source/ beside Dockerfile. The image reuses the existing CUDA 12.4 ownerapi image and its llama.cpp checkout; no host driver change is needed.
rebuild.source_integrity: The inspected upstream checkout was clean at the recorded tag and full commit SHA. No Strata source patch was applied.

rollback.procedure: Stop the owned Flash-Next service when idle; restore its installed unit and project run/launcher copies from rollback, align the workspace launcher assertion to owner9950x3d2, daemon-reload and start the unit. Original model/profile files were not replaced.

client_check.launcher: scripts/opencode.sh --run (with the documented SSH target/root environment)
